content.sentence: At the beauty contest, the first runner-up was __________ than the winner.
It was __________ to cook once a week than to cook daily.
It was __________ to buy some groceries wholesale than in smaller quantities.
They wanted a __________ house than their current house.
The new technician was __________ than the previous one and could manage the repairs and office administration.
His new job at a high-rise building was __________ than the work he did before.
The practical examination was __________ than the theory exam.
The practical sessions were __________ than the theory classes.
The marketing team in her new job was __________ than the team she worked with before.
The design exhibition by the seniors this year was __________ than the exhibition held last year.

activity_b.text: At the beauty contest, the first runner-up was more beautiful than the winner.
It was more practical to cook once a week than to cook daily.
It was more economical to buy some groceries wholesale than in smaller quantities.
They wanted a more modern house than their current house.
The new technician was more efficient than the previous one and could manage the repairs and office administration.
His new job at a high-rise building was more dangerous than the work he did before.
The practical examination was more difficult than the theory exam.
The practical sessions were more interesting than the theory classes.
The marketing team in her new job was more professional than the team she worked with before.
The design exhibition by the seniors this year was more impressive than the exhibition held last year.

Questions.question: Which vibration indicator was more accurate?

activity_b.text: Good morning, Faris. I need to update our equipment log for this week.
What are you doing now?
Good morning, sir. I’m checking the maintenance sheets from yesterday.
We ran out of several mechanical tools during the assembly and alignment tasks.
Yes, the workshop was very active yesterday.
Did you see which items are missing?
Yes, sir. We used many precision torque extensions, but one brand was more stable and more durable than the other.
The silver extension worked well, but the blue one slipped more easily.
I noticed that too. The silver extension is definitely better.
We are going to order more of that model.
What about the adjustable bearing pullers?
We used the last few.
We also need shaft-centering dowels, but I think the hardened-steel type is sturdier than the aluminium one.
The aluminium dowels bent during the test run.
Then we will order the hardened-steel ones.
Did you check the hydraulic line-pressure gauges?
Last week, the supplier said the newest batch was more reliable than the previous one.
Yes, sir. I tested them.
The new gauges had a better display, but two gauges leaked slightly.
I informed the supplier yesterday and returned them.
Good decision. Leaking gauges can cause serious problems.
Now, I’m going to prepare a new supply request.
What quantities do we need?
Order ten precision torque extensions, eight adjustable bearing pullers because they are lighter and easier to handle, and twelve hardened-steel centering dowels.
Excellent. What about dynamic vibration indicators?
The instructor said the red model was more accurate when checking misalignment.
Yes, sir. I compared them yesterday.
The red indicator gave clearer readings.
The grey indicator was slower and less stable during measurement.
Then we will change to the red model.
Anything else?
Yes, sir. We also need flexible coolant-delivery nozzles.
The modular type is stronger and more practical than the fixed one.
Good idea. I’ll add them to the list.
Thank you, Faris. You are getting better at identifying high-quality tools.
Thank you, sir. I enjoy learning more about mechanical equipment.
